Lower Text: [Opponent's Turn][Once Per Turn] When one of your opponent's Digimon attacks, by returning 2 [Vemmon] from any of your [Galacticmon]'s digivolution cards to the bottom of the deck, change the attack target to this Digimon.
Upper Text: [On Play][When Digivolving] Delete up to 3 play cost's total worth of your opponent's Digimon and Tamers. For each [Vemmon] in this Digimon's digivolution cards, add 1 to this effect's play cost maximum.
When this would be played, you may place specified cards from your hand/battle area under it. Each one reduces the cost.
